question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
WITH distinct_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    CASE 
      WHEN year LIKE '% %' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(year, INSTR(year, ' ') + 1))
      ELSE year
    END as year_num
  FROM Movie
),
movie_years AS (
  SELECT MID, 
    CASE 
      WHEN year LIKE '% %' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(year, INSTR(year, ' ') + 1))
      ELSE year
    END as year_num
  FROM Movie
),
period_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    dy.year_num as start_year,
    COUNT(my.MID) as film_count
  FROM distinct_years dy
  JOIN movie_years my ON CAST(dy.year_num AS INTEGER) <= CAST(my.year_num AS INTEGER)
    AND CAST(my.year_num AS INTEGER) <= CAST(dy.year_num AS INTEGER) + 9
  GROUP BY dy.year_num
)
SELECT start_year, film_count FROM period_counts ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 1
